notes.title: Game Progress Log (October 18, 2024)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I apologize for the delay, and it's an honor to release the first community message on Steam!

After six months of development and iterative updates, our game, "Sandtable Engine," has undergone significant changes and improvements.
Not only have we enriched the design philosophy and functionalities of the game's engine itself, but we have also made new decisions regarding the issues related to the operation of the game. 

- Due to development cycle issues, we hope to present a more stable version to you, and the game release date has been postponed to before the summer of 2025.
- The game is planned to participate in the  February 2025 Steam New Game Festival.
- The game has been officially confirmed as a  free-to-play game (the standard version is free by default), and the "Premium" version, which does not affect core functions, will be presented as a DLC.
- The game will fully support free commercial use and customization and packaging.
- The game world will have more diverse functions and designs, and support more game view and API for gameplay.
- More to come... 

The developers are confident in the creative ideas behind the "Sandtable Engine," and we will work to develop and test it as quickly as possible in the coming time. If you are interested, please feel free to add it to your Steam wishlist (even though it is a free game). 

We will gradually update and showcase new content in the near future! 

- Thanks, Greetings from the developers.
